description: This file defines the class actionSendEmail, which extends actionBase and handles sending emails within the SuiteCRM workflow. It includes methods for loading email templates, parsing templates, retrieving email addresses based on various criteria, sending emails with attachments, and maintaining email sending status.

classes.name: actionSendEmail
classes.description: Class responsible for sending emails in SuiteCRM workflows, managing email templates, parsing templates, handling attachments, and tracking email success/failure counts.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the email sending action and resetting email status counters.

methods.name: loadJS
methods.description: Returns the JavaScript files needed for the email sending form.

methods.name: edit_display
methods.description: Generates the HTML for the edit view of the email action, including email options, templates, and recipient details.

methods.name: getEmailsFromParams
methods.description: Extracts email addresses from provided parameters based on various target types and related beans.

methods.name: run_action
methods.description: Executes the email sending process using a specified email template and recipient list, with support for individual or bulk emails.

methods.name: clearLastEmailsStatus
methods.description: Resets email success and failure counters to zero.

methods.name: getLastEmailsFailed
methods.description: Returns the count of emails that failed to send in the last run.

methods.name: getLastEmailsSuccess
methods.description: Returns the count of emails successfully sent in the last run.

methods.name: parse_template
methods.description: Performs variable substitution within email templates based on bean fields and related data.

methods.name: getAttachments
methods.description: Retrieves attachments associated with an email template, typically notes linked to the template.

methods.name: sendEmail
methods.description: Handles the actual email transmission, including setting recipients, subject, body, attachments, and saving email records.
